title: Monthly review of accounts of Government of India upto June 2026 (FY 2026-27)
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Finance

Monthly review of accounts of Government of India upto June 2026 (FY 2026-27)

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
05 AUG 2026 4:34PM by PIB Delhi

The monthly accounts of the Government of India upto the month of June, 2026 has been consolidated and reports published. The highlights are given below: -

The Government of India has received ₹10,49,243 crore (28.7% of corresponding BE 2026-27 of Total Receipts) upto June, 2026 comprising ₹6,36,576 crore Tax Revenue (Net to Centre), ₹3,77,664 crore of Non-Tax Revenue and ₹35,003 crore of Non-Debt Capital Receipts. ₹2,63,336 crore has been transferred to State Governments as Devolution of Share of Taxes by Government of India this period which is ₹63,605 crore lower than the previous year.

Total Expenditure incurred by Government of India is ₹13,57,076 crore (25.4% of corresponding BE 2026-27), out of which ₹10,16,818 crore is on Revenue Account and ₹3,40,258 crore is on Capital Account. Out of the Total Revenue Expenditure, ₹3,46,414 crore is on account of Interest Payments and ₹1,14,812 crore is on account of Major Subsidies.
